description.value: Joe's Pizza Carmine Street is a classic New York slice shop. It was established in 1975 by Joe Pozzuoli and is a "Greenwich Village institution". The shop is now three doors down at 7 Carmine Street. Restaurantji lists the 7 Carmine Street shop at 4.2 from 1076 ratings. Representative Restaurantji praise (guest reviews): “Let me tell you, the classic NY style pizza is just *chefs kiss*”. Representative watch-outs: “Sauce is great, but on the lighter side”.
